title: PR 21 and 24 closing comments
text: Closing comments for PRs #21 and #24 (both already in the game), to post and close on your OK. #21 (CinnamonVII): "Thank you for this, and for rebasing it with the fixes from #12. It no longer applied to current code, so we ported it manually with you as co-author on the commit, and partly built lines now run their longest built stretch in the game. Closing this one since it's in. Thanks again!" #24 (caelum418): "Closing this now that the port is in the game (it shipped in 0.4.5, as the reply above says). Thanks again for the speedup and the write-up!"
